title: Fall back to the next matching row when a role hits a vendor limit

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: On 2026-10-26 Codex ran out of credits in the middle of two ork relays (S125 fix round, S127 first round). Nothing in the contract said what to do; the owner picked a Claude row by hand and the partial diffs were finished by it. ork decided (adj 156) to fall back only on a classified limit (rate limit, out of credits) to the role's next matching matrix row, and S133 classifies Codex out-of-credits. `relay-roles recommend` already lists alternatives.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/ai.py`: Stop and Rules in both contract texts.
- `src/slicer/cli.py`, `src/slicer/ops.py`: a reason on `relay-run step`, if missing.
- The contract golden fixture.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
On a classified vendor limit, the orchestrator records the failed step with the reason, starts the same round on the role's next matching row (the alternatives `recommend` lists) with the partial diff, and names the switch in the run report. Any other failure still stops.

Owner decisions: fold this change into the unreleased relay contract v10 (extend its RELAY_CHANGES entry and the v10 golden fixture); do not bump to v11.
